newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Feb manufacturing input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Australian Feb manufacturing input prices fall.

text.p: Australian manufacturing input prices fell 0.5 percent in February from the previous month and were 3.8 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
"Price falls for locally produced crude oil were the main contributors to the fall in the index," the bureau said.
Australian manufacturing input prices have fallen in all but five of the past 15 months and their annual inflation rate has remained between minus 2.6 percent and minus 5.6 percent since May.
